urlencoded.description: (Required) JWT authentication token
Email address of the account. You should use this or username.
Username of the account. You should use this or the email address.
MD5 password. You should use this or the plain text password.
Plain text password. You should use this or the passhash.
Indicates if the subuser is admin or not. Default value is 0, which means that the subuser is not admin.
The name of the company to which the subuser belongs

Allow or restrict subuser access to creating new forms. This works only for non-admin subusers.

Possible values: 0, 1, 2 or 3.

0 (default value) = No access to creating new forms

1 = Forms are available only to this user

2 = Forms are available to current users from parent company

3 = Forms are available to all current users
Allow subusers to duplicate forms. Default value is 0, which means that the subuser cannot duplicate forms.
Allow subusers to delete forms. Default value is 0, which means that the subuser cannot delete forms.
Allow admin subusers to manage groups. This works only for admin subusers. Default value is 0, which means that the subuser cannot manage groups.
Allow admin subusers to manage users. This works only for admin subusers. Default value is 0, which means that the subuser cannot manage users.

info.name: 123FormBuilder REST API v2 Accounts Users API

description.content:
REST API v2 for 123FormBuilder. Manage forms, retrieve and update submissions, list fields, administer users, groups, and accounts. Authenticate by exchanging credentials at /token for a JWT, then pass the token on subsequent requests.
